title: Income Tax Department Rolls Out Second Set of Statutory Forms & Seamless Payments Across Both Acts
content:
# Income Tax Department Rolls Out Second Set of Statutory Forms & Seamless Payments Across Both Acts

Hello everyone! Ek important update hai Income Tax Department ki taraf se. The Department has announced the rollout of the second set of statutory forms under the Income Tax Rules, 2026, along with a much-awaited feature for seamless payments across both Income-tax Acts. This is a significant step towards streamlining our tax compliance processes.

Here's what you need to know:

*   **Second Set of Statutory Forms:** 13 more statutory forms, including various quarterly forms, are now live on the e-filing portal. These forms are crucial for compliance under the new Income-tax Act, 2025, and the Income-tax Rules, 2026.
*   **Where to Access:** You can find these new forms by navigating to: E File → Income Tax Forms → File Income Tax Forms → Forms as per Income Tax Act 2025 → Select the form (as applicable) on the e-filing portal.
*   **Seamless Payments:** The e-filing portal now supports seamless tax payments for both the Income-tax Act, 1961 (for dues up to FY 2025-26) and the new Income-tax Act, 2025 (for Tax Year 2026-27 onwards). This integrated payment module will definitely make our lives easier, allowing us to make all payments from a single interface.
*   **Background:** Remember, the Income-tax Rules, 2026, were officially notified by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) through G.S.R. 198(E) dated March 20, 2026, and came into effect from April 1, 2026, replacing the earlier rule structure under the Income-tax Act, 1961. These new rules and forms are part of a comprehensive overhaul aimed at simplifying compliance.

Do check out the updated forms and leverage the new payment facility for smooth compliance!
